description: Receipt gate: a Stop hook that blocks claiming completion while a spec under .fable-advisor/pending/ lacks a complete receipt (fail open without python — it is a ratchet, not the primary guardrail).

hooks.command: payload=$(cat); if py -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=py; elif python3 -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python3; elif python -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python; else R=; fi; if [ -n "$R" ]; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$R" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/receipt-gate.py"; else echo 'fable-advisor receipt gate skipped: python runtime missing (fail open — the gate is a ratchet; pending specs are re-checked when a python runtime returns)' >&2; fi
